searchText: In a way, mainnet is the incentivized testnet. I've been committed to this worldview since the moment I heard it. ETH2 phase 0 is a testnet in all but name - no smart contracts, no withdrawals, just a large scale incentivized test for the PoS beacon chain I think that's good... actually adding the word "testnet" to it wouldn't be appropriate since real value is at stake. Yes, that could rub people the wrong way. And phase 0 is still a big step and technological achievement in its own right
